# Rewritr

> Smart, local, privacy-first text replacement Chrome extension. Free to use. No account required.

## What is Rewritr?

Rewritr is a Chrome browser extension that lets users find and replace text on any webpage. All processing happens locally in the browser — no data is ever sent to a server. It is free and open for personal use with a Pro tier planned.

## Key capabilities

- Find and replace text on any webpage using literal strings or regex patterns
- Unicode-aware regex with capture group support ($1, $2, $0)
- Per-rule flags: Case Sensitive (Cs), Regex mode (Rx), Whole Word (Ww), Smart Case (Sc)
- "Replace only in contenteditable" toggle — restricts replacements to editable areas (Google Docs, Notion, Gmail, rich text editors) while leaving static page text untouched
- Dynamic mode — MutationObserver watches for new DOM content and re-applies rules automatically (useful for SPAs, infinite scroll, live feeds)
- Skip <pre> and <code> blocks independently
- Bookmark / save named rule sets and reload them instantly
- Import and export rules as JSON
- Keyboard shortcut: Alt+Shift+F opens the popup from any tab
- Supports 60+ languages including Latin, Cyrillic, CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean), Arabic, and Indic scripts

## Privacy

Rewritr collects zero personal data. No analytics, no telemetry, no network requests from the extension. Rules are stored in chrome.storage.sync (local/Google sync). The website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages.
